tax.text: Schroeder says she would suspend the gas tax, use the state surplus to cut taxes, defend Proposition 13, and oppose new tax increases.
tax.quote: I will vote to suspend the Gas Tax, use the state's surplus to cut your taxes, and defend Proposition 13 so families aren't taxed out of their homes. I oppose any new tax increase.

schools.text: Schroeder says she would support parental rights and school choice while auditing education spending.
schools.quote: I will fight for parental rights and school choice, defend parents' voice in their kids' education, and audit education spending so every dollar reaches the classroom.

safety.text: Schroeder opposes defunding the police and says she would hold prosecutors accountable and keep dangerous felons behind bars.
safety.quote: I oppose "Defunding the Police." I will fight for tougher penalties for repeat offenders, hold rogue DAs accountable, stop the refusal to prosecute, and keep dangerous felons behind bars.

sentencing.text: Schroeder says she would seek tougher penalties for repeat offenders and keep dangerous felons incarcerated.
sentencing.quote: I will fight for tougher penalties for repeat offenders, hold rogue DAs accountable, stop the refusal to prosecute, and keep dangerous felons behind bars.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Schroeder says she would protect girls' sports and girls' private spaces.
gender.quote: I will audit Child Protective Services, support families in crisis, and protect girls' private spaces and girls' sports.

energy.text: She says she would suspend the gas tax as part of making basic costs more affordable.
energy.quote: I will vote to suspend the Gas Tax, use the state's surplus to cut your taxes, and defend Proposition 13 so families aren't taxed out of their homes.
